findings.title: Psycast.GetGizmos ignores showWhenDrafted, so the drafted branch can drop pawns vanilla still groups
findings.detail: Ability.GetGizmos hides the gizmo when drafted && !showWhenDrafted, but Psycast overrides GetGizmos and always yields Command_Psycast. For a modded psycast with groupAbility=true and showWhenDrafted=false, drafted pawns are on the shared button but the filter in OpenMenu (AbilityAIAutocast.cs:148) leaves them out, so the menu sets only some of them. No vanilla def combines the two flags. If wanted: in the drafted case test `(a is Psycast || def.showWhenDrafted)`.

findings.title: Group filter skips vanilla's player-controlled check (visiblePrimary)
findings.detail: Pawn_AbilityTracker.GetGizmos only shows ability gizmos when IsColonistPlayerControlled / IsColonyMechPlayerControlled / IsColonySubhumanPlayerControlled / IsColonyAnimal; IsColonistPlayerControlled is false during a mental state. Offers checks only Faction.IsPlayer and !IsPrisoner, so a selected colonist in a mental break joins `pawns` even though its gizmo isn't drawn. Harmless (the player selected it) but not strictly 'the pawns the button represents'.
